adversarial.orchestration: Reader begins and acquires state epoch 0; writer commits coupled state+graph epoch 1; reader then first-touches graph DB.

interpretation: Explicit source-epoch pinning is a valid strong counterbaseline: it detects the demonstrated cross-file mixed snapshot and recovers on a fresh transaction. Co-location therefore must beat this guarded design, not an unguarded two-store strawman. In this local warm read microbenchmark the guarded two-file layout still costs about 18.5% more p50 and incurs one retry in every deliberately forced skew trial.
claim_boundary: Marker-level mechanism evidence only; the full Clay receipt contract is stronger and must be compared separately.
